title.value: Bayesian Structure Learning with Generative Flow Networks
title.justification: The title explicitly states the focus of the paper which is on Bayesian Structure Learning using Generative Flow Networks.
title.quote: Bayesian Structure Learning with Generative Flow Networks

extractions.description: This paper presents a novel approach to Bayesian structure learning using Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets). It proposes DAG-GFlowNet as an alternative to MCMC for approximating the posterior distribution over Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) in Bayesian networks. The method constructs graphs sequentially one edge at a time, improving the approximation of the posterior over graphs compared to traditional methods such as MCMC and variational inference. The authors demonstrate applications on both simulated and real data, showcasing its capability to handle observational and interventional data.
